body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-023-offer-reality-check.md (v2.2, builds on SC-019). Built before gating on 18 Oct 2026 and reviewed twice (docs/report/report-claude-opus-5.5.md section 12 and a second review that fixed a percent-overflow crash). Do not call Gemini in tests. Money is integer LKR. Cut-off 17:00 Colombo (D6).

Offer Reality Check (offercheck.py, Wallet step), Gemini catalog matching and fractional quantities for v2 receipt uploads, extraction off the event loop, the Ask-the-agent box, the swapped-role guard, session receipts in the agent's pantry, merged duplicate agent rows, simulated-saving wording, --max-instances=3 and live checks in docs/deploy.md.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Reality check, exclusions, minimum, cap, planner agreement, validation. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_offer_check.py -q
2. Wallet offer path, Gemini catalog match, swapped-role guard. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v22_page.py -q
3. Every test passes. Verify: python -m pytest -q
4. README checker passes. Verify: python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
title: v2.2 build: Offer Reality Check, Gemini-necessary receipts, ask the agent
